definitions: To stop a problem or an unwanted situation at an early stage before it has a chance to develop and become more serious.
To prevent something undesirable from growing or continuing by ending it quickly at the beginning.
examples: We need to nip this rumour in the bud before it spreads.
The manager decided to nip the issue in the bud by addressing it immediately.
It's best to nip bad habits in the bud when they first appear.
